api_references.name: Forever secure targeting and leveling statistics
api_references.scope: Secure macrotext hardware-click action, raidtarget set-unmarked action, public UnitXP/UnitXPMax/UnitLevel/UnitIsAFK and player XP events. No native code copied. Activity time uses session clock, excludes offline/pause/AFK; client event order and protected actions await live verification. Rare discovery also uses public UnitClassification, UnitCanAttack, UnitIsDeadOrGhost, UnitGUID, UnitName and UnitLevel from native nameplate/target/mouseover events; protected target buttons update outside combat. Party follow resolves the actual connected group leader using UnitIsGroupLeader, UnitIsConnected and accessible UnitName/name-realm data. The native FOLLOW slash handler passes its literal message to FollowUnit; a secure hardware-click macro uses that name, with updates deferred in combat. Group/leader/name events refresh the button. Live follow and cross-realm verification remain pending.

api_references.name: Forever native taxi selection
api_references.scope: TakeTaxiNode(slotIndex) on the native taxi button; current-master node IDs, reachability and slot mapping come from C_TaxiMap.GetAllTaxiNodes. No fees checked or progress inferred from the call. A single secure post-hook observes native TakeTaxiNode slot requests from the current reachable-node snapshot. A recent ground-to-UnitOnTaxi transition starts display timing; the selected native node names and existing Flights.Seconds provide destination and pure airborne ETA, excluding boarding. Different selections are detached from the old planned flight. Reloads without an observed start show only flight state. Countdown never advances navigation; native landing and position still acknowledge arrival. Hook order, native selection and timer display await live verification.

api_references.name: Forever planned training and binding
api_references.scope: BuyTrainerService uses the matching available native service index for the selected training intent after resolving its actual tooltip spell identity; late tooltip data reuses native refresh events. Binding confirmation is deferred until after CONFIRM_BINDER and rechecks the planned inn, NPC, location and native Binder interaction before ConfirmationInteraction/ClearInteraction. Native used/spell-book or HEARTHSTONE_BOUND facts still acknowledge completion. No balances or fees are checked.

api_references.name: Forever planned service gossip
api_references.scope: Native GetOptions status and base icon, SelectOption(gossipOptionID) and SelectOptionByIndex(orderIndex). Service icons follow the independently verified RestedXP behavior: trainer 132058, taxi 132057, binder 132052; shared icon 136458 also requires the native localized HOME token. Planned NPC or flight departure, live gossip context, quest priority, fresh plan, manual overrides and repeated-event suppression are checked before selection. No completion or flight departure is inferred from opening a service window.

api_references.name: Forever quest details and chat links
api_references.scope: GetQuestLink takes a quest ID; native quest UI uses ChatFrameUtil.InsertLink and OpenChat to place links in the chat editor. QuestMapFrame_OpenToQuestDetails opens a selected quest. AiLeveling checks the current native GetLogIndexForQuestID before opening accepted quest details; unaccepted tasks reuse their existing plan preview. Only explicit mouse actions invoke these operations; current task, locks and progress are preserved. Layout, native window interaction and chat editor behavior await live verification.
